Enhanced Voting / Scytl CDN export fixture.

Source URL: https://app.enhancedvoting.com/cdn/results/Georgia/export-2024NovGen.json
Fetch date: 2026-10-27

Trimmed to four contests (President, US House 1, State House 1, Constitutional
Amendment 1) with county/precinct breakdowns removed. The full export is the
same format used by Georgia's Secretary of State and is expected to be the
format Arizona uses for its 2026 general election.
